description: End-to-end identity, company, and trust verification workflow for B2B enterprise telecom sales, from initial lead risk assessment through multi-step KYC/KYB verification, remediation, escalation, and final approval.

verification_request_id.description: Primary identifier for an identity verification request

case_id.description: Compliance or risk case identifier linked to a verification request

document.description: Generic document object for identity or company verification

document_id.description: Internal reference to the uploaded document

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of document issuance

side.description: Which side of the document, if applicable

person_identity.description: Standardized structure for a person's identity attributes

id_number.description: Primary government ID number used for verification

company_profile.description: Standardized structure for company identity and registration details

jurisdiction.description: Company registration jurisdiction (country/state code or registry code)

audit_event_id.description: Identifier of an audit log entry.

subscription_id.description: Identifier of a webhook or notification subscription.

snapshot_id.description: Identifier of a captured state snapshot.

functions.name: initiate_verification_request
functions.description: Create a new identity and trust verification request for a B2B enterprise prospect or existing customer.

company_id.description: Existing internal company_id if this is for an existing enterprise; omitted for new leads.

external_reference.description: Optional CRM or opportunity ID from external systems (e.g., Salesforce Opportunity ID).

request_type.description: Type of verification required based on relationship and product scope.

products_requested.description: List of product families or capabilities to be enabled, used for risk profiling.

estimated_monthly_spend.description: Estimated monthly spend in the billing currency.

primary_contact.description: Primary commercial contact initiating the verification.

role.description: Role of the contact within the organization.

risk_profile_hints.description: Optional hints from sales or pre-sales about expected risk posture.

geographic_exposure.description: Countries where services will be delivered or traffic will originate/terminate.

traffic_profile.description: Summary of expected usage (e.g., 'A2P SMS global', 'voice termination to high-risk routes').

reseller_model.description: If the customer is a reseller, describe the downstream customer model.

callback_config.description: Configuration for asynchronous status callbacks to external systems.

callback_url.description: HTTPS endpoint to receive status updates.

credentials.description: Auth-specific credential payload (e.g., username/password, token, secret).

events.description: List of events to send callbacks for.

functions.returns: New verification_request_id with initial risk assessment stub and next required actions.

functions.name: submit_identity_documents
functions.description: Submit and link identity and company documents to an existing verification request for KYC/KYB processing.

verification_request_id.description: Identifier of the verification request to associate documents with.

company_documents.description: List of company-level documents (e.g., certificate of incorporation, tax registration).

beneficial_owners.description: List of beneficial owners or controlling persons required for KYB.

documents.description: Identity or proof-of-address documents for the beneficial owner.

authorized_signatories.description: Authorized signatories who can bind the company contractually.

title.description: Job title or legal capacity (e.g., 'CFO', 'Power of Attorney').

documents.description: Identity documents and authorization letters for the signatory.

attestation.description: Electronic attestation and consent for processing personal data.

accepted_terms_version.description: Version identifier of the KYC/KYB terms accepted.

accepted_by_ip.description: IP address from which acceptance occurred.

signature_reference.description: Reference to a signature artifact (e.g., envelope ID, file ID).

functions.returns: Updated verification request with linked documents and status of initial document completeness checks.

functions.name: run_preliminary_risk_assessment
functions.description: Execute automated preliminary risk checks (PEP, sanctions, watchlists, fraud signals) for a verification request.

run_scopes.description: Types of automated checks to run.

override_config.description: Optional override for scoring thresholds and rule sets.

providers.description: Override which third-party providers to use per scope.

async.description: If true, run checks asynchronously and return immediately with a tracking token.

functions.returns: Preliminary risk assessment results including risk score, flags, and whether manual review is required (or async job reference).

functions.name: get_verification_status
functions.description: Retrieve current status, progress, and outstanding actions for an identity verification request.

mask_sensitive.description: If true, mask PII and sensitive values in the response for low-privileged viewers.

functions.returns: Verification request status, including overall state, sub-statuses (KYC, KYB, credit), and outstanding requirements.

functions.name: list_verification_requests
functions.description: List and filter identity verification requests across the enterprise portfolio for dashboards or reporting.

assigned_team.description: Filter by manual review team or queue.

has_open_case.description: Filter by presence of an open compliance case.

functions.returns: Paginated list of verification requests with summary attributes and counts by status.

functions.name: create_manual_review_case
functions.description: Create and assign a manual compliance or risk review case linked to a verification request.

reason_codes.description: Machine or analyst-provided reason codes triggering manual review.

notes.description: Free-form note explaining the manual review context.

assignment.description: Assignment routing for the manual review case.

assignee_id.description: Specific analyst ID if directly assigned.

sla_hours.description: Target SLA to complete this case, in hours.

functions.returns: New case_id, initial case status, and routing details for manual review.

functions.name: request_additional_information
functions.description: Request additional documents or clarifications from the customer during identity verification.

case_id.description: Optional linked manual review case ID, if the request originates from a case.

requirements.description: Detailed list of required additional information items.

requirement_id.description: Client-defined identifier for tracking this requirement.

description.description: Human-readable description of what is needed.

document_constraints.description: Constraints if a document is required.

deadline.description: Deadline for the customer to provide the requested information.

blocking.description: If true, decision cannot be finalized until this requirement is met.

delivery_channels.description: Channels to notify the customer about the additional information request.

message_template.description: Optional customization for the notification message.

functions.returns: Recorded additional information requirements, notification dispatch status, and updated verification sub-status.

functions.name: submit_additional_information_response
functions.description: Submit responses and additional documents against previously requested remediation items.

responses.description: List of responses corresponding to requested requirement items.

text_response.description: Clarification or descriptive response if applicable.

documents.description: Documents supplied to fulfill this requirement.

submitted_by.description: Information about the submitter of the remediation response.

functions.returns: Updated requirement statuses (fulfilled/partially_fulfilled/rejected) and triggering of re-evaluation if conditions met.

functions.name: finalize_verification_decision
functions.description: Record the final decision for an identity verification request, including rationale, conditions, and limits.

decision_source.description: Whether the decision was automated, manual, or a hybrid.

approver.description: Information about the decision maker (system or human).

items.description: Document IDs referenced in the decision.

conditions.description: If conditionally approved, specify conditions and limits.

notify_customer.description: If true, trigger outbound communication of the decision to the customer.

functions.returns: Final decision record with effective status change, applied conditions, and notification dispatch results.

functions.name: cancel_verification_request
functions.description: Cancel an in-progress verification request, with audit trail and optional rollback of downstream dependencies.

rollback_options.description: Optional rollback of linked objects (e.g., temporary accounts, credit holds).

preserve_documents.description: If false, mark documents for secure deletion per data retention policy.

functions.returns: Cancellation confirmation, including final status, any rollback actions performed, and compliance retention notes.

functions.name: retry_failed_check
functions.description: Retry a previously failed automated check (e.g., sanctions, credit, fraud) for a verification request with updated parameters if needed.

previous_check_id.description: Identifier of the prior failed check instance, for traceability.

corrections.description: Optional corrected data used for the retry (e.g., updated names, DOB).

retry_reason.description: Explanation of why the retry is being initiated.

functions.returns: New check execution reference and updated status for the specific check type (or async job token).

functions.name: escalate_verification_case
functions.description: Escalate a verification-related case to higher authority or specialist team with context and requested action.

verification_request_id.description: Optional associated verification request if not implicitly linked by case.

reason.description: Detailed description of why escalation is needed.

attachments.description: Supporting documents or internal memos for escalation.

sla_override_hours.description: Optional SLA override for the escalated case.

functions.returns: Escalation record with updated case routing, new assignee or queue, and target SLA.

functions.name: sync_verification_to_crm
functions.description: Synchronize final or intermediate identity verification outcomes back to external CRM or billing systems.

sync_scope.description: Scope of data to be synchronized.

crm_identifiers.description: Mappings between internal and CRM entities.

field_mappings.description: Optional custom field mappings for advanced integrations.

target_field.description: Destination field in the external system.

dry_run.description: If true, simulate sync without persisting changes to the external system.

functions.returns: Sync job result with success/failure per field and any errors or conflicts encountered.

functions.name: search_verification_requests
functions.description: Faceted search across verification_request records with rich filters, full-text query, and faceted aggregations for identity_verification_flow.

filters.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

highlight.description: Return highlighted snippets when matching text

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token for stable pagination

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A paginated result set of verification_request records with facet buckets, total count, and continuation cursor.

functions.name: list_verification_requests_by_status
functions.description: List verification_request records filtered by lifecycle status with stable cursor pagination.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token for stable pagination

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A paginated list of verification_request records matching the requested statuses, optionally with summary metrics.

functions.name: get_verification_request_detail
functions.description: Fetch a single verification_request record with optional expansion of related entities and versioned snapshots.

as_of.description: Read the record as of this point in time

version_id.description: Specific version to retrieve when versioning is enabled

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A verification_request record with the requested expansions and version metadata.

functions.name: bulk_create_verification_requests
functions.description: Submit a batch of verification_request records for creation, with idempotency keys and partial-success reporting.

tags.description: Tags applied to the new record

trace_id.description: Correlation id propagated across the batch

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A per-item outcome list with created identifiers, validation errors, and batch-level statistics.

functions.name: bulk_update_verification_requests
functions.description: Apply partial updates to many verification_request records in a single transactional batch.

selector.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

patch.description: JSON merge-patch applied to every matched record

dry_run.description: Compute affected count without applying changes

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Affected record count, sampled previews, and any per-record errors.

functions.name: bulk_archive_verification_requests
functions.description: Soft-archive verification_request records matching a selector with optional grace period before purge.

selector.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

preserve_audit.description: Keep audit trail even after purge

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Archive operation summary including matched count, scheduled purge date, and any blockers.

functions.name: export_verification_requests
functions.description: Asynchronously export a filtered slice of verification_request records to the configured object store.

selector.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

destination.description: Where the export should be delivered

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: An export job descriptor with status, destination URI, and progress callbacks.

functions.name: subscribe_verification_request_events
functions.description: Register a webhook subscription for verification_request lifecycle events with HMAC signing and replay protection.

filter.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

signing_secret_ref.description: Reference to the HMAC signing secret

tls_verify.description: Whether to validate the server certificate

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A subscription handle including subscription_id, verification status, and current delivery health.

functions.name: unsubscribe_verification_request_events
functions.description: Disable or delete a previously created verification_request event subscription.

drain_seconds.description: Grace period to flush in-flight events

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Final subscription state and any undelivered event counts at the time of termination.

functions.name: get_verification_request_audit_history
functions.description: Retrieve the chronological audit log for a verification_request including who changed what and when.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token for stable pagination

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: An ordered list of audit entries with diffs, actor metadata, and correlation ids.

functions.name: query_verification_request_changelog
functions.description: Query the cross-record changelog for identity_verification_flow with field-level filters.

selector.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

fields_changed.description: Restrict to changes touching these fields

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token for stable pagination

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Aggregated changelog rows or detail entries depending on group_by, plus totals.

functions.name: schedule_verification_request_job
functions.description: Create a recurring or one-off scheduled job that runs a identity_verification_flow operation.

operation.description: Operation name to invoke when the schedule fires

input_template.description: Parameters passed to the operation, with templating

failure_policy.description: What to do when a run fails

max_failures.description: Pause schedule after this many failures

alert_channel.description: Channel id to alert on failure

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A schedule descriptor including schedule_id, next run time, and validation issues.

functions.name: pause_verification_request_schedule
functions.description: Temporarily pause a scheduled identity_verification_flow job without deleting its history.

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Updated schedule status and prior pause history.

functions.name: simulate_verification_request_execution
functions.description: Run a dry-run simulation of a identity_verification_flow execution path without producing side effects.

include_side_effect_plan.description: Return the side effects that would have been emitted

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Simulation transcript with predicted outcome, side-effect plan, and assertions checked.

functions.name: preview_verification_request_change
functions.description: Compute a preview of how a proposed change would affect a verification_request prior to commit.

evaluate_policies.description: Run policy engine against the proposed state

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A preview document with field diffs, policy verdicts, and dependency impact.

functions.name: submit_verification_request_for_approval
functions.description: Submit a verification_request for review with configurable approver routing and SLA targets.

approver_group.description: Group or role authorised at this step

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Approval workflow handle with approval_id, current step, and projected completion time.

functions.name: record_verification_request_approval_decision
functions.description: Record an approve/reject/recuse decision for a pending verification_request approval step.

conditions.description: Conditions attached to a conditional approval

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Updated approval state, next pending step, and any triggered automations.

functions.name: escalate_verification_request
functions.description: Escalate a stuck or breached verification_request to a higher tier with paging and audit.

target_team.description: Team or rota receiving the escalation

context_refs.description: Related artifact ids attached for context

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Escalation record id, paged responders, and acknowledgement timer.

functions.name: add_verification_request_comment
functions.description: Append a comment, optionally with @mentions and visibility scope, to a verification_request.

mentions.description: User ids mentioned in the body

parent_comment_id.description: Comment id this one replies to

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Newly created comment record including comment_id and resolved mentions.

functions.name: attach_verification_request_evidence
functions.description: Upload an evidence file or link as an attachment to a verification_request with content hash and retention.

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Attachment descriptor including attachment_id, content hash, and stored URI.

functions.name: snapshot_verification_request_state
functions.description: Capture a point-in-time snapshot of a verification_request and its dependencies for restore or audit.

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.description: Compute summary KPIs for identity_verification_flow over a time window with optional segmentation.

query.description: Query spec, polymorphic by panel type

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

rules.description: Ordered rule list, first match wins

when.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

enforcement_mode.description: How strictly the policy is applied

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Policy version descriptor with policy_id, version_id, and validation report.

functions.description: Evaluate the active identity_verification_flow policies against a candidate input and return verdicts.

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Aggregate verdict, per-rule outcomes, and any obligations attached to the decision.

functions.description: Declare typed dependency links between a verification_request and related artifacts to drive impact analysis.

replace_existing.description: Replace prior links of the same relations

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization
